text:
emily: FYI — People Ops proposing a combined Q2 mandatory training: Workplace Harassment + InfoSec (approx 35 min). Draft handbook update and schedule here: https://docs.internal/redwood/hr/q2-training-draft
rafael: Combined training sounds efficient. Whats the completion window and enforcement?
emily: Target window: Apr 10Apr 24 for managers; all individual contributors by May 1. Enforcement: completion required for role eligibility (managers) and highlighted in handbook. This aligns with the upcoming external compliance audit.
sara: Please add an accommodations clause for neurodiversity, extended timelines for new parents, and folks on medical leave.
tom: Agreed. Also clarify if this changes the handbook frequency language (annual vs biannual).
legal-team: Draft currently says "annual". Recommend: keep annual baseline + allow ad-hoc mandatory cohorts after major policy changes. No legal blockers at first glance.
emily: Thanks. We'll update handbook wording to reflect that. Also planning a short quiz after training; passing threshold = 80%. Failed attempts auto-assign remedial module.
ops-admin: I'll schedule two manager walkthroughs: Apr 11 9:00am PT and Apr 13 4:00pm PT. Calendar invites will be sent to manager distribution list.
rafael: How will completion be tracked centrally?
emily: We'll use the People Ops tracker: https://sheets.internal/redwood/peopleops-training-tracker. compliance-bot will sync daily to S3: s3://redwood-compliance/q2-training/completions-<ts>.
compliance-bot: 1764007960: Daily completion sync uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/q2-training/completions-1764007960.csv
sara: Also ensure new hires within 30 days get auto-assigned, and that managers get an automated reminder at 72h if not completed.
emily: HRIS rule will auto-assign within 48h of onboarding; ops-admin please confirm reminders.
ops-admin: Confirmed  onboarding assignment in 48h, reminders at 72h and 7 days.
tom: For managers who miss both live sessions, auto-enroll in the next live session and schedule a 1:1 with HR within 7 days.
emily: Noted. Handbook page to update: Learning & Compliance -> Training Requirements. We'll bump the handbook version to 4.3.2 when published.
legal-team: We'll add the formal sign-off stamp and provide retention guidance for completion records (3 years).
rafael: Can People Ops produce a brief manager FAQ and a 10-min leader briefing video to accompany the rollout?
emily: Yes. I mocked an FAQ doc and a leader video draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/hr/q2-training-assets. Please review.
sara: Accessibility check: ensure video has captions and a transcript, slides have alt-text.
emily: Will include captions, transcript, and alt-text. Thanks for flagging.
compliance-bot: 1764008190: Manager completion CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/q2-training/manager-completions-1764008190.csv
emily: Action items: ops-admin  calendar invites & HRIS automation; rafael  draft manager FAQ by Apr 6; sara  review handbook language & accommodations; legal-team  final sign-off; compliance-bot  daily syncs. I will publish and post in #announcements after legal sign-off.
rafael: I'll have the FAQ draft up by EOD today.
tom: I'll coordinate leader video recording and help edit.
legal-team: Targeting sign-off by Apr 5 EOD.
emily: Great. I'll follow up in this thread with the publish timestamp. Thanks all :rocket:
